packageFailureReportedSeparatelyByCoordi.detail: Root reproduced package-source expanded size147MB above120MiB and assigned producer/consumer correction. This focal does not exercise or approve that package.

limits: Three actual toolbar controls measured centrally in six workspace states per system; not universal WCAG certification.
Static PNGs and native focal checks do not approve all clicks, animation, scrolling, VoiceOver or other workspaces.
Source recovery changes are retained for provenance but not exercised by this appearance-only focal.
Full native matrix, source/runtime installer packaging, recovery paths, physical M4 and production services are outside this approval.
Transport tar/app is not downloaded, extracted or executed locally; original workflow pack/restore and metadata provide the same-bundle declaration binding.
